title: Line sketch: Sunset Over City Bridges
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A sweeping urban landscape at hour shows a wide river crossed by arched bridges, reflecting the blazing sun, with a dense skyline of skyscrapers rising against dramatic clouds. The composition layers foreground infrastructure, midground water, and distant towers beneath a centered sun. Thick, expressive and saturated color blocks create a stylized, painterly effect (derived from painting #95).
